answer: Quorum means distance, not headcount. A ballot counts only when signers’ willow trails show no shared node for three hops and terminate at distinct violet roots; saffron is burned to re-root a trail across one fork, and each fork crossing counts once. Shared timing, escrow or keys make willow fold heads into one trail, so a further voice from that operator must cross one more fresh fork than the last: voice two burns 2 saffron, voice three burns 3. First voice: one root, one fork, 1 saffron. Ten fakes require ten violet roots and 55 saffron; a new address still ends at that node.
